audit.external_2026_check: European Commission confirms 17 January signature and 1 May interim provisional application; Brand Finance dated 12 June 2026 confirms all four ranks and 193-state, >150000 survey framework
audit.historical_spot_checks: Rev4 directly checked Garcia 1833 p32, 1932 p76, 1969 p106; rev5 wording for these years and 1981 is consistent at targeted level, but 205 year-by-year passages were not fully revalidated.

issues.location: EN and PT-BR second ```chart``` (Brand Finance ordinal positions 11,29,33,43)
issues.evidence: type: bar plots raw rank numbers on proportional bar widths. Rank is ordinal (1 is best), so larger bars visually encode more quantity while actually denoting a worse position; the report itself concedes that distances are not cardinal. Captions do not eliminate the misleading encoding under RESEARCH-VISUALS evidence rules 2,3,4,8 and QA rule 'materially misleading chart'.
issues.required_correction: Replace with an ordinal rank table or a visual grammar explicitly suitable for ordered categorical positions; if keeping chart, use a documented ranking visualization where direction and non-cardinality cannot be mistaken for amount of influence, with identical EN/PT implementation.

issues.location: Annual chronology EN/PT 1976, 1989, 2007 and other broad interpretive years
issues.evidence: 1976 asserts African and energy relationships 'enlarge external policy options' using only Garcia year-search; 1989 says the end of the Cold War 'opens new coalitions and trade disciplines' with broad integration PDF and Garcia year-search; 2007 says technical cooperation, agriculture and energy diplomacy 'expand' using a generic ABC institutional history and Garcia year-search. These are analytical effect/change claims rather than merely dated events. No located dated passage or comparative evidence demonstrates the asserted expansion/mechanism for these specific years. A #search=YEAR fragment is not a passage-level validation. This audit does not assert the claims are false; they remain insufficiently traced.
issues.required_correction: For each interpretive annual claim, provide pinpoint passage and evidence of the asserted change or label it explicitly as a period interpretation without pretending the linked year proves it. Complete a year-to-claim concordance and review both locales.

accepted_qualifications: Garcia is a secondary historical chronology through 2008, not 205 original primary archival records.
1833 recognition is attributed retrospectively; no contemporaneous dated Brazilian dispatch claimed.
UN Security Council decade chart totals 11 starts and is internally arithmetically consistent.
EU–Mercosur provisional application is correctly distinguished from final ratification.
Brand Finance 2026 is a cross-sectional perception survey, not a causal historical measure.
Targeted EN/PT year wording and visual numeric arrays match.
limitations: Full 205-year external passage-by-passage source audit not completed; no blanket assertion of falsity.
Only targeted external web verification of European Commission and Brand Finance performed in this run.
No reports, public indices, staged source or approval record modified.
